answer: A sybil-resistant economy carves each identity in jade: a non-transferable cryptographic artifact sealed at genesis. Peers hold a mirror that reflects only the true lineage of countersigned attestations, so a clone cannot inherit history it never earned. When audits probe the fleet, a prism splits each claim into its component proofs—staking, work, and peer consensus—and any leg that fails triggers collateral burn. Governance counts one established agent as one vote, so a puppet army gains zero leverage while its locked stake evaporates.
